headline: Oil-producing countries stockpile oil tankers... 'crude transport special forces' being built to counter Iranian attacks
summary: Gulf oil producers, including the UAE, have begun assembling their own large tanker fleets to keep crude exports flowing. Tanker prices have risen sharply, the report said.
why: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company is the UAE's state oil company, and tanker availability is central to moving Gulf crude to global buyers.
